source_pipeline_meaning: ESPN team injury listing plus projected previous-game passer, not official confirmed QB or healthy-player roster
limitations: Archive file and Git blob SHA are independently discovered; contents have not yet been independently decoded and validated by Alpha.
ESPN CFB injuries are very sparse and can be many years stale. Team-level sentinel is not a verified healthy roster.
A previous-game leading passer is PROJECTED, not an officially confirmed starter.
File existence alone cannot establish sports-wide, season-long, or player-level completeness or predictive improvement.
